subject: literacy
concept: Evaluating whether evidence in a text actually supports its central claim
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Truth Seeking Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts evidence cards into 'strongly supports the claim' and 'weakly connected' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a claim to the piece of evidence that most directly supports it
exercise.abstract: Student evaluates whether a given piece of evidence genuinely supports an author's claim

misconception_flags: accepts a loosely related or anecdotal piece of evidence as strong support for a broad claim

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
